items.title: Moderna Sinks 7% as Analyst Day Cancer Push Brings “$4 Billion in Cash Costs in 2027”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna shares fell 7% today after the company guided to cash costs of about $4 billion in 2027 and $4 billion to $4. 5 billion a year through 2030, mostly for oncology.

items.title: Why Is Moderna (MRNA) Joining A Global Benchmark And Publishing New Vaccine Data?
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) is scheduled to join the MSCI World Index in November 2026, which would add the stock to a major global benchmark. The biotech group reported publication of real world data on its mNEXSPIKE COVID-19 vaccine in older adults in a peer reviewed journal. The new study compared mNEXSPIKE effectiveness in reducing severe COVID-19 and hospitalizations among older adults against other available options. items.title: Moderna Raises 2026 Revenue Growth Forecast to 15%–25% and Reports Progress in Cancer Vaccine Development
items.summary: Moderna, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNA) increased its 2026 revenue growth forecast to between 15% and 25%, compared with its previous outlook of up to 10%, as the biotechnology company outlined financial expectations and clinical development updates during its 2026 Analyst Day in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
